story: On a slow Sunday in January, Ali and Rosa make lunch together. Ali makes a large sandwich with many chips inside. They stand near the window to eat. Rosa talks about her new hobby and a number of books. They enjoy the meal because it is possible to relax.
title: A Sunday Lunch
setting: A bright kitchen on a Sunday morning.

characters.name: Ali
characters.look: A young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt.

characters.name: Rosa
characters.look: A young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress.

sentences.en: It is a slow Sunday in January.
sentences.zh: 这是一个缓慢的一月的星期日。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali and Rosa are in a bright kitchen on a sunny January morning.

sentences.en: Ali and Rosa make a big lunch.
sentences.zh: Ali和Rosa制作了一顿丰盛的午餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali with short black hair and Rosa with long brown hair are standing in the kitchen.

sentences.en: Ali must make a large sandwich.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali is putting bread on a wooden table.

sentences.en: He puts chips inside the bread.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali is putting golden potato chips between two slices of bread.

sentences.en: The sandwich is full of food.
sentences.zh: 这个三明治里装满了食物。
sentences.scene_prompt: A very large sandwich sits on a white plate.

sentences.en: They stand near the window to eat.
sentences.zh: 他们站在窗户旁边吃东西。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali and Rosa are standing by a large window in the kitchen.

sentences.en: Rosa talks about her new hobby.
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa is smiling and talking to Ali while eating.

sentences.en: A funny thing can happen today.
sentences.zh: 今天可能会发生一件有趣的事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali and Rosa are laughing together in the kitchen.

sentences.en: She will take a number of books.
sentences.scene_prompt: Rosa is picking up a small stack of books from the table.

sentences.en: They enjoy the lunch together now.
sentences.zh: 他们现在一起享受午餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali and Rosa are eating happily at the table.

sentences.en: Being calm is possible for them.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，保持冷静是可能的。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali and Rosa are sitting comfortably in the bright kitchen.
